race.comment: METRIC (15) has been right there in all three runs this preparation including placing over this distance range at Doomben at the latest effort. Gets the services of leading hoop Thompson in the irons and maps ideally for this contest from gate three. Low at the weights and looks ready to break through. IMMINENT APPEAL (3) hit the frame at the Sunny Coast when facing the starter for the first time and will have derived a bunch of benefit from that race day experience. Can feature with natural improvement. The well-related VEOMAS (8) (half to G1 winner Seabrook) rounds out the selections with the reliable Gollan/Jones combination. Look for improvement from RECONCILIATE (10) second-up.
